visualCharacteristics.purpose: Bordered text-only cards (values, offerings) in a wrapping grid
visualCharacteristics.layout: 3-column grid on desktop by default (2 on tablet, 1 on mobile); the two-col option keeps 2 columns on desktop
visualCharacteristics.description: Bordered cards each holding a heading and paragraph, optionally a tag above the heading and a ghost (secondary) CTA at the bottom. Shown on a dark (inverse) band on the About page.

contentPattern.structure: one row per card, one text cell: [optional tag paragraph, H3 or H4 heading, description paragraph, optional link]
contentPattern.notes: The paragraph directly before the heading is the tag. A trailing paragraph holding only a link is the CTA and is pushed to the card bottom; author it in italics for the ghost (secondary) button style. Extra cells in a row are merged into the same card. The dark band comes from Section Metadata (style: inverse).

usage: What We Believe section on the WKND Adventures About page (3 columns); 2-column offering cards on /adventures (two-col).
reuseGuidance: Use for look-alike text-only items in a grid. For cards with images use cards-article; for numbered steps use columns-numbered.
